summary: Request for delivery of media with new software
body: Richard Mayhem ( System Administrator) to Arnold Trendler ( Head of Security ) - Hello, I felt it was urgent to report my suspicions about my colleague Kyle, I noticed that he had been extremely suspicious since he started working in our department, he was extremely interested in asking me about the sorting of data from the internal media of the security robots, in addition, I noticed that during his lunch break he almost always spends his time in our internal storage room. In addition, a couple of days ago, the head of our department noticed the loss of several extremely important disks with the hardware limitations of our models
